items.title: Health Care Professional Recruitment
notes: Report from D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer
D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer introduced Angela Stanley, President and CAO of the Wellington Health Care Alliance.

Angela Stanley discussed the current challenges with health care recruitment and changes to the delivery of the care model. She further provided suggestions on how to improve recruitment by offering accommodations to physicians temporary servicing the community and when visiting to consider this location as well as providing offices and/or office space for clinicians.

Dan Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer updated the Council on the history of assisting with health care recruitment which traditionally has been $20 000 a year and providing subsidized office space. In response to questions from Council, he indicated staff is requesting Council’s approval to establish a working group to bring recommendations back to Council to assist with the issues in health care.

items.title: Zoning Amendment RZ016/22 - 7197 Wellington Road 21, Pilkington
notes: Report from M. Iglesias, Senior Planner

M. Iglesias, Senior Planner outlined the report, indicating the rezoning application is for 7197 Wellington Road 21 in the former Township of Pilkington. The application seeks to rezone the 26 ha retained farm parcel to add an exception to the Agricultural zoning to prohibit residential uses as required by Provincial and County policies for farm dwelling surplus severances. She further indicated no objections were received from the public or agencies on this application.

items.title: Zoning Amendment RZ018/22 - 7158 Third Line, West Garafraxa
notes: Report from M. Iglesias, Senior Planner

M. Iglesias, Senior Planner outlined the report, indicating the subject property is located at 7158 Third Line, in the former Township of West Garafraxa which currently supports an active farming operation and residential dwelling. The zoning amendment would add an exception to the Agricultural zoning to prohibit residential uses as required by Provincial and County policies for farm dwelling surplus severances. The severed parcel with the dwelling also requires an exception to recognize a reduced rear yard setback for the existing barn. She further indicated no objections were received from the public or agencies.

items.title: Partial Demolition at Listed Property - 170 Johnston Street North, Fergus
notes: (Rear Addition)
Report from M. Iglesias, Senior Planner

M. Iglesias, Senior Planner indicated the application is to remove the rear one storey addition which is in poor condition and the owner intends to rebuild a new two storey addition. She indicated Heritage Centre Wellington had no objections to the proposed demolition.

items.title: Heritage Permit Application HP2023-002 - 19 George Street, Salem
notes: Report from M. Iglesias, Senior Planner
M. Iglesias, Senior Planner indicated this is a protected heritage property.

A heritage permit was approved by Council in June of 2022, however, the owner is requesting a change to the approved plans to reinstate an attic and provide flexibility to allow the use of board and batten as an additional option to stone for the restoration fronting on Washington Street.

items.title: RFP#01-23 Corporate Strategic Plan
notes: Report from S. Lloyd-Smith, Manager of Purchasing and Risk Management

Adam McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer reviewed the report. items.title: 2023 Budget By-law
notes: Report from A. McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer

Adam McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer outlined the report, explained the by-law is required to enact the 2023 budget, calculate and set tax rates, and enable staff to carry out the capital items which have not been pre-approved.

items.title: Surety Bond Policy
notes: Report from A. McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer

Adam McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer indicated staff is recommending the Township accept Surety Bonds as an acceptable form of security to replace letters of credit from active developers. He explained previous to letters of credit municipalities required performance bonds.

items.title: Performance Planning - CAO

R. Hasan, Chief Human Resources Officer gave a presentation outing the performance planning and evaluation process for the Chief Administrative Officer of the Township. He reviewed the principles to guide the performance evaluation and how Council will provide feedback as part of the process. Finally, he reviewed the proposed CAO Performance Evaluation template.
